# World Bank Codes

> Official global directory for US ABA Routing Numbers, UK Sort Codes, Australian BSB Numbers, Canadian Transit/EFT Codes, Indian IFSC & MICR, Russian BIK Codes, UAE CBUAE Routing, Bangladesh BEFTN Routing & SWIFT/BIC Codes.

## Overview
World Bank Codes is an open financial directory providing verified banking routing and clearing identifiers for over 8 countries and 10,000+ financial institutions and branches worldwide.

## Key Capabilities & Tools
- **Global Search**: Instant lookup by bank name, branch name, state, city, IFSC, ABA Routing, Sort Code, BSB, BIK, CBUAE, or SWIFT/BIC.
- **Routing Number Validators**: Real-time checksum verification and structure validation for national clearing codes.
- **SWIFT / BIC Code Finder**: ISO 9362 international SWIFT code decoder and directory.
- **Branch Directory**: Granular branch addresses, phone numbers, localized names, and clearing network support.

## Supported Countries & Code Systems
- **United States (US)**: 9-digit ABA Routing Transit Numbers (Fedwire & ACH)
- **United Kingdom (UK)**: 6-digit Bank Sort Codes & CHAPS/Faster Payments
- **Canada (CA)**: 5-digit Transit, 3-digit Institution & 9-digit EFT Routing
- **Australia (AU)**: 6-digit BSB (Bank State Branch) Numbers & APCA Clearing
- **United Arab Emirates (AE)**: 9-digit CBUAE Routing, UAEFTS & 23-character IBAN
- **India (IN)**: 11-character RBI IFSC Codes, 9-digit MICR Codes
- **Bangladesh (BD)**: 9-digit BEFTN Routing Numbers & BACPS Clearing
- **Russia (RU)**: 9-digit BIK (БИК) Codes & Correspondent Accounts
